articles.summary: Results from the Phase 3 VELA clinical trials in adults with moderate-to-severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) show that clinical responses continue to improve to Week 40, with 62% of patients treated with sonelokimab (SLK) achieving HiSCR75 and up to 32% of patients achieving HiSCR100 An analysis
articles.title: MoonLake announces Week 40 Results from its Phase 3 Clinical Trials of Sonelokimab in Hidradenitis Suppurativa at the 2026 AAD Annual Meeting
